name: Solana Warehouse Worker
description: Heavy-duty warehouse robot with mecanum wheels and 6-DOF manipulator arm

workflow.name: Initialize Scene
workflow.prompt:
Clear and initialize the Blender scene:

1. Delete all default objects
2. Set units to Metric, scale 1.0
3. Create collections: 'Robot', 'Arm', 'Environment', 'Lights'
4. Add ground plane 8m x 8m at Z=0
5. Set up industrial lighting:
   - Main area light: 2000W at (3, -3, 4)
   - Fill light: 800W at (-3, -2, 3)
   - Rim lights: 2x 400W at (±2, 4, 2)
6. Camera at (2, -2, 1.2) pointing at (0, 0, 0.3)
7. Cycles render engine, 1920x1080

workflow.name: Create Main Chassis
workflow.prompt:
Create the reinforced warehouse robot chassis:

1. Main body:
   - Cube scaled to 0.45m x 0.40m x 0.10m
   - Position at (0, 0, 0.08)
   - Heavy-duty industrial design

2. Add structural reinforcement:
   - Cross-beam pattern on underside
   - Visible through wheel wells

3. Create wheel mounts at four corners:
   - Reinforced motor housings
   - Position at (±0.18, ±0.15, 0.05)

4. Create arm mounting platform:
   - Raised platform on top: 0.20m x 0.15m x 0.02m
   - Position at (0, -0.08, 0.11)
   - Bolt pattern visible

5. Add side panels:
   - Ventilation grilles on sides
   - Access panels with hinges

6. Apply material:
   - 'mat_industrial_gray' - Color RGB(0.25, 0.25, 0.28)
   - Metallic: 0.7, Roughness: 0.4
   - Add subtle scratches/wear

7. Name: 'robot_chassis_warehouse'
8. Add to 'Robot' collection

workflow.name: Create Mecanum Wheels
workflow.prompt:
Create four mecanum wheels for omnidirectional movement:

For each wheel position (FL, FR, RL, RR at ±0.18m, ±0.15m):

1. Create wheel hub:
   - Cylinder radius 0.03m, depth 0.05m
   - Central mounting plate

2. Create outer frame:
   - Two circular rings (inner and outer)
   - Connect with 6 spokes

3. Create mecanum rollers (9-12 per wheel):
   - Small barrel shapes: radius 0.012m, length 0.025m
   - Angled 45° to wheel axis
   - IMPORTANT: Front-left and rear-right angle one way
   - Front-right and rear-left angle opposite
   - Array around wheel circumference

4. Create motor housing:
   - Cylindrical housing behind wheel
   - Visible wiring channel

5. Apply materials:
   - Hub: 'mat_aluminum_anodized' - Black anodized
   - Rollers: 'mat_rubber_gray' - Color RGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), Roughness 0.7
   - Frame: 'mat_steel' - Metallic 0.95

6. Name: 'robot_mecanum_FL', 'robot_mecanum_FR', etc.
7. Parent to chassis

workflow.name: Create Arm Base
workflow.prompt:
Create the robot arm base and first joint:

1. Base motor housing:
   - Cylinder radius 0.06m, height 0.08m
   - Position on arm mount platform
   - Heavy-duty servo appearance

2. Create rotating base plate:
   - Disc on top of base motor
   - Radius 0.055m, thickness 0.01m
   - Visible bearing ring

3. Create first arm segment mount:
   - Vertical bracket
   - Connects to shoulder motor
   - Height 0.05m

4. Add cable routing:
   - Spiral cable wrap from base
   - Connector panel on back

5. Add base indicator LEDs:
   - Ring of small LEDs around base
   - Show rotation position

6. Apply materials:
   - Motor housing: 'mat_servo_black' - Color RGB(0.08, 0.08, 0.1)
   - Base plate: 'mat_aluminum_machined' - Metallic 0.9

7. Name: 'robot_arm_base'
8. Add to 'Arm' collection

workflow.name: Create Arm Segments
workflow.prompt:
Create the two main arm segments:

Shoulder to Elbow Segment:
1. Main arm body:
   - Rounded rectangular profile: 0.05m x 0.04m x 0.18m
   - Tapered design (wider at shoulder)
   - Internal cable channel

2. Shoulder joint:
   - Motor housing at top
   - Pitch rotation axis

3. Elbow joint:
   - Motor housing at bottom
   - Connection to forearm

Elbow to Wrist Segment:
1. Forearm body:
   - Slightly smaller profile: 0.04m x 0.035m x 0.15m
   - Tapered toward wrist

2. Elbow connection:
   - Bearing housing
   - Cable pass-through

3. Wrist mounting:
   - Compact wrist assembly mount

For both segments:
- Add panel lines and details
- Cable routing clips along length
- Apply 'mat_arm_white' - Color RGB(0.92, 0.92, 0.95), Metallic 0.3
- Name: 'robot_arm_upper', 'robot_arm_forearm'
- Parent segments in chain: base > upper > forearm

workflow.name: Create Wrist Assembly
workflow.prompt:
Create the 2-DOF wrist assembly:

1. Wrist pitch mechanism:
   - Compact servo housing
   - Allows up/down rotation
   - Size: 0.035m x 0.03m x 0.04m

2. Wrist roll mechanism:
   - Cylindrical housing
   - Continuous rotation capable
   - Diameter 0.03m, length 0.04m

3. Tool mounting flange:
   - Standard robot tool flange
   - Circular with bolt pattern
   - Diameter 0.05m

4. Add details:
   - Position sensors
   - Cable connector
   - Tool quick-release mechanism

5. Apply materials:
   - Match arm segment material
   - Flange: machined aluminum look

6. Name: 'robot_arm_wrist'
7. Parent to forearm

workflow.name: Create Parallel Gripper
workflow.prompt:
Create parallel jaw gripper end effector:

1. Gripper body:
   - Housing: 0.08m x 0.05m x 0.04m
   - Contains linear actuator
   - Mounts to wrist flange

2. Create finger rails:
   - Two parallel rails
   - Fingers slide on these

3. Create gripper fingers (2x):
   - L-shaped profile
   - Base slides on rail
   - Tip extends down: 0.06m
   - Rubber pad on gripping surface

4. Create finger tips:
   - Replaceable rubber pads
   - Textured gripping surface
   - Serrated pattern

5. Add sensors:
   - Force sensor in each finger
   - Proximity sensor at fingertip
   - Small camera between fingers

6. Apply materials:
   - Body: 'mat_gripper_gray' - Color RGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.22)
   - Fingers: 'mat_aluminum_anodized'
   - Pads: 'mat_rubber_black'

7. Name: 'robot_gripper'
8. Parent to wrist

workflow.name: Create 3D LiDAR
workflow.prompt:
Create Velodyne-style 3D LiDAR:

1. Main body:
   - Cylinder diameter 0.10m, height 0.12m
   - Position at (0, 0.20, 0.22) on elevated mount
   - Domed top

2. Create rotating head:
   - Multi-faceted drum shape
   - 16 or 32 channel appearance
   - Visible optical windows

3. Create optical apertures:
   - Array of small windows around head
   - Stacked vertically for multi-beam

4. Create base:
   - Mounting plate with connector panel
   - Cable exit port
   - Status LEDs

5. Create elevated mount:
   - Vertical post from chassis
   - Vibration dampening base
   - Height 0.10m

6. Apply materials:
   - Body: 'mat_lidar_black'
   - Windows: 'mat_glass_ir' - Slight red tint

7. Name: 'robot_lidar_3d'
8. Parent to chassis

workflow.name: Create Safety Features
workflow.prompt:
Add industrial safety features:

1. Emergency stop button:
   - Large red mushroom button
   - Position on top rear of chassis
   - Yellow base plate with 'E-STOP' text
   - Diameter 0.05m

2. Warning stripes:
   - Yellow and black diagonal stripes
   - On all edges of chassis
   - 45° angle, 0.02m stripe width

3. Safety bumper:
   - Compliant rubber bumper around perimeter
   - Pressure sensors integrated
   - Black rubber material

4. Warning lights:
   - Rotating beacon on rear
   - Orange/amber color
   - Emission material when active

5. Safety labels:
   - 'CAUTION: MOVING PARTS' decals
   - Pinch point warnings near arm
   - Maximum load capacity label

6. Proximity sensors:
   - Additional sensors around chassis
   - For collision avoidance

7. Apply emissive materials to warning lights
8. Parent all to chassis

workflow.name: Create Electronics Bay
workflow.prompt:
Create the electronics compartment:

1. Jetson Orin Nano:
   - Same as delivery bot spec
   - Position at (0.10, 0, 0.10)
   - Include heatsink and fan

2. Motor controllers:
   - 4x motor driver boards
   - Positioned near each wheel
   - Heat sinks attached

3. Power distribution:
   - Main power board
   - Fuse panel
   - Position at (-0.10, 0, 0.10)

4. Dual battery packs:
   - Two large LiPo packs
   - 6S 10000mAh each
   - Position at (0, ±0.10, 0.08)

5. Communication module:
   - WiFi/BT module
   - 4G/LTE modem option
   - GPS antenna mount

6. Cable management:
   - Organized cable harness
   - Labeled connectors
   - Strain relief clips

7. Create access panel:
   - Hinged cover
   - Ventilation slots

8. Name and parent all components

workflow.name: Create Forklift Tines
workflow.prompt:
Create optional forklift attachment:

1. Tine assembly:
   - Two parallel tines
   - Length 0.40m, width 0.05m, thickness 0.02m
   - Position at front of robot
   - Slight upward curve at tips

2. Create lift mechanism:
   - Vertical frame at front
   - Height 0.30m
   - Linear actuator for lifting

3. Create carriage:
   - Horizontal beam connecting tines
   - Slides on vertical frame
   - Roller bearings visible

4. Create backrest:
   - Vertical plate behind tines
   - Prevents load from sliding back
   - Height 0.25m

5. Add load sensors:
   - Strain gauges on tines
   - Weight display panel

6. Apply materials:
   - Tines: 'mat_steel_painted' - Color RGB(0.9, 0.6, 0.1) - Orange
   - Frame: 'mat_steel_black'

7. Name: 'robot_forklift_assembly'
8. Parent to chassis front

workflow.name: Add Branding and Final Details
workflow.prompt:
Complete the robot with branding and details:

1. Solana branding:
   - Large Solana logo on sides
   - 'SOLANA ROBOTICS' text on front
   - Gradient purple-cyan color scheme

2. Model designation:
   - 'WW-2000' model number
   - Serial number plate
   - QR code for identification

3. Status display:
   - Small LCD screen on top
   - Shows battery, mode, task info
   - Size: 0.08m x 0.05m

4. Load capacity markings:
   - 'MAX LOAD: 50KG' on arm
   - 'LIFT CAPACITY: 100KG' on forklift

5. Maintenance access points:
   - Labeled access panels
   - Lubrication points marked

6. Final checks:
   - All objects properly parented
   - Materials assigned
   - Origins set correctly
   - Save as 'solana_warehouse_worker.blend'
